scope: Source implementation acceptance; not a published release or deployed service

environment.account: Official user login and quota, handled only by agy
environment.transport: Isolated native processes controlled through the OriginRouter local API and Hooks

runtime.modelChangeStrategy: Wait for full idle, stop old child, resume the exact native conversation with session flags, observe configuration acknowledgement

checks.name: App background startup, native model catalog and initial message
Real model response and tool execution through native Hooks
Model restart with accepted request acknowledgement
Effort restart and observed native configuration
Native command and content capability snapshot
Native question answer through App local control
Actual token usage without fabricated price or quota
Stop, exact native history resume and real post-resume response

supplementaryIsolatedChecks.name: Local OriginRouter approval prompt and keyboard decision
Execution mode restart with native acknowledgement
PNG upload, native reading and correct image recognition
Busy message queue and repeated message-ID deduplication
App text attachment and Hook approval
App resume retains the recorded native runtime
Session-bound originrouter_native_device MCP with native and device approvals
Daemon restart re-registers the existing wrapper and same native conversation

appFocused.scope: Targeted App regression; not a complete App suite

additionalCoverage: Retained ACP resume and native/ACP MCP namespace separation
User MCP configuration preservation and inactive bare-agy tools
Exact question result acknowledgement, including rejection of prefix-only matches
Live native child writer lock after wrapper loss
Attachment validation and private file boundaries
Proxy fallback and gateway/native model control separation

notAcceptedByTheseChecks: Windows or Linux native process execution
A physical phone through the deployed public relay
notAdvertised: Generic native MCP forms or URL authorization responders
Automatic interrupt-and-continue recovery without a formal native cancellation acknowledgement
General native background-task or fork control
limits.versionGate: Native menu and content drivers are enabled only for tested agy 1.5.13; other versions retain basic native operation

privacy: Aggregate results only. No raw terminal output, account identifiers, credentials, conversation IDs or private filesystem paths are included.
